title: Trump Says Vandals Slashed the Reflecting Pool — Scientists Say It’s Just Algae
summary: Have you ever seen a pond turn bright green in summer? That’s usually algae — tiny plants that grow fast in warm, sunny water. But President Trump says something much scarier happened at the famous Reflecting Pool in Washington, D.C. The long, shallow pool in front of the Lincoln Memorial just got a super expensive makeover. Trump wanted it painted “American flag blue” for the 4th of July. But last week, the water turned green. Trump posted on social media that vandals used knives to cut a 250-foot-long gash in the pool’s new lining and poured in “corrosive and destructive chemicals.” He said park police arrested several people and the pool would be drained and fixed. But here’s the twist: scientists who study water say the green color is from a natural algae bloom. One professor even tested the water and found it wasn’t toxic. A man named David Hearn was arrested, but he says he only touched a loose blue piece in the pool — he didn’t damage anything. As of now, no police agency has confirmed any arrests for vandalism. The pool’s renovation cost over $14 million — way more than the $2 million first planned. A company got the job without competing for it. Another company was paid $1.7 million to fight the algae with special technology. A nonprofit even sued, saying the government skipped important reviews. So is it a crime scene or just nature doing its thing? For now, the mystery is still floating.
why_it_matters: This mystery shows how important science is in solving everyday puzzles, and that famous landmarks can become the center of big arguments about money, trust, and the truth.

background_read: The Reflecting Pool is a long, shallow pool in front of the Lincoln Memorial in Washington, D.C., the capital of the United States. The Lincoln Memorial is a huge monument honoring President Abraham Lincoln.
Algae are tiny plants that live in water and can multiply very quickly in warm, sunny weather, turning ponds and pools bright green.
Article_Structure: WHO: President Donald Trump, water scientists, and a man named David Hearn.
WHAT: President Trump said vandals used chemicals to turn the Reflecting Pool green for July 4th. Scientists say the color came from natural algae.
WHERE: The Reflecting Pool at the Lincoln Memorial in Washington, D.C.

WHY: The pool was newly renovated and painted blue for Independence Day, but the green water caused confusion and arguments over what really happened and whether millions of dollars were spent wisely.

perspectives.description: They believe the pool was attacked on purpose and that arrests prove the danger to a national treasure.
They say the green water is just a normal algae bloom that happens in warm weather and tested not toxic, so no crime happened.
Some people are upset that the renovation cost over $14 million—way more than planned—and that the money might have been wasted no matter what turned the water green.
